title: cheilanthes pallens
intro: Cheilanthes pallens, commonly known as the pale rattlesnake fern, is a species of fern in the genus Cheilanthes. It is a medicinal plant used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include treating respiratory issues, digestive problems, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Cheilanthes pallens include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe and protect the body from harm. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
